decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewithApplication Form, Covering Letter, Planning Statement, Existing Topographical Survey,  Design and Access Statement, Landscape Planning Report, Arboricultural Report, Flood Risk Assessment (Appendix C - Thames Water Asset Location Plan),  Drawings: 3242/SK23A Site Plan, OX4748-2-001 P01 General Arrangement and Temporary Landscape Treatment,3242/SK19B Ground Floor Plan, 3242/SK20B First Floor Plan, 3242/SK22A Roof Plan, 3242/SK21C Proposed Elevations, 3242/SK17C Proposed Section, OX4748-1-200 Deterrent Paving to Site Entrance

Received 23/07/12

 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The marketing suite building (upper floor) and use (sui generis) hereby permitted  shall be
discontinued and the building restored to its former approved condition and uses under application  00657/B/P/21 on or before 5 years from the date of this consent in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Details of all fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of construction at the site. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation of the buildings full details of both hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 8 - The landscaping approved under Condition 7 shall ensure only for the duration of the temporary planning consent and shall be restored in accordance with the approved landscaping details under Condition 11 of permission 00657/B/P21 on/before the date this use ceases, or in accordance with a timescale agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Should the applicant need to encroach further on the bund to enable landscaping works this will require a further application.

Condition : 9 - No occupation shall take place until a Delivery and Servicing Plan for the use in the gatehouse has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 10 - The commercial uses hereby approved shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 7:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays. Any pavement caf? or other exterior activity ancillary to any of the approved temporary uses, shall not be open for business outside the hours of 8:00 to 22:00 on the aforementioned days.
Condition : 11 - No amplified music or other music shall be played outside the commercial premises hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 12 - The A1/A3/B1(a)/B1(b) gatehouse uses granted by this  permission shall be for a limited period expiring 5 years from the date of this consent when the use shall cease.

Condition : 13 - Historic landscape features (the bunds and filter beds), unless shown as being removed on the approved drawings, shall not be removed, infilled, bridged, altered, damaged or destroyed
without prior approval of the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Erection of a temporary purpose-built, two storey marketing suite together with assocated access/egress, parking, refuse arrangements, provision of a linear park and soft and hard landscaping works including the alteration and restoration of the existing filter bed banks and alterations to the existing southern listed boundary wall to create pedestrian connections,  and the refurbishment of the existing listed gatehouse for use classes A1/A3/B1(a)/B1(b) for a 5 year period
